duration.text: The Pharmacy at Liaoning University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: "*" means necessary documents that you must provide in your application.*1. English proficiency test certificateFor example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English.*2. Provide financial proof (or bank certificate) that can guarantee one year tuition fee.*3. Blank Page in Your Passport*4. Passport first page, visa page (please ensure continuity).*5. Two-inch personal photo with blue or white background.*6. High school academic transcriptAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: academic transcript in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.*7. High school graduate certificateAccording to Liaoning Province Government Requirement: Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese should be translated into Chinese and be certified by notarization. If you can not find translation organization, please contact CUCAS. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China.8. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good ConductProvided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate.

requirements.text: (1) Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens with valid passport, with good moral conduct, in good health, in friendly relation with China and observe Chinese laws, regulations and university's rules and regulations. Applicants who have already resided in China should apply 40 days before the expiration of residence permit.(2) If both parents or one of the parents of the applicant are Chinese citizens and reside in a foreign country, the applicant shall have foreign nationality at birth and shall hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for at least 4 years. In addition, applicants must provide a record of at least 2 years of actual residence in a foreign country during the last 4 years (April 30, 2018 to April 30, 2022). The actual residence of more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit signatures. For residences of mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan who immigrated to foreign countries and are applying as international students, please refer to the requirements above. (3) Applicants should reach the admission requirements, such as grades, academic level and language proficiency.(4) Language proficiency requirements:English-spoken Programs: IELTS 5 (at least) or TOEFL 60 (at least)(5) Applicants for Bachelor: Academic credentials equivalent to Chinese senior high school.
